Name: Quick Combat and Mining
Author: y709408040
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968214-1490972359.jpg[/img]
[size=5][b]Six actions. One touch away.[/b][/size]
[color=#e9ba68]ANDROID • 0.4.8 • ENGLISH / 简体中文[/color][/center]

[center][size=4][b]简体中文介绍[/b][/size]
点击下方 [b]Show[/b] 展开完整中文图文介绍；再次点击同一按钮收起。English description continues below.[/center]
[spoiler]
[size=5][b]六个动作，触手可及。[/b][/size]
为《星露谷物语》安卓版准备的快捷战斗与采矿按钮。左手移动，右手随时使用[b]弹弓、近战武器、镐子、炸弹、楼梯和食物[/b]，减少在快捷栏里来回寻找工具的操作。按钮可自由摆放、调整大小，也能随时通过屏幕上的 ON/OFF 开关隐藏或恢复。

[b]0.4.8 换上了更贴近游戏的 UI：[/b]暖色像素圆形边框、居中的原色物品图标、原生风格布局编辑器，以及游戏原生 HUD 状态提示。熟悉的六个动作和自定义功能依然完整保留。

[size=5][b]安装前置[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]《星露谷物语》安卓版 1.6，以及与游戏版本兼容的 [b]SMAPI for Android[/b]。[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu（GMCM）：必备前置。[/b]安装官方主文件；作者实测版本为 [b]1.16.0[/b]，用于在游戏内配置本模组。[/*]
[/list]开发环境：Stardew Valley Android 1.6.15.3 / SMAPI Android 4.3.2.5。其他 Android SMAPI 组合的表现可能不同，本模组主要面向移动端。
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968214-1328444355.jpg[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]炸开空间，继续探索[/b][/size]
点击炸弹按钮，直接使用背包中的普通炸弹。放置遵循游戏原生规则，只有成功放置才消耗物品。
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968393-313580543.gif[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]吃点东西，喝一杯，接着出发[/b][/size]
食物按钮分别检查食物与饮品增益，优先补齐缺失的类别；恢复时结合无增益食物、相同增益以及尽量减少浪费的规则选择物品。支持偏好、排除项和恢复兜底设置。[b]每次点击最多吃或喝一个物品，不会在后台自动进食。[/b]下面是两次分别点击：一次食物，一次饮品。
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968393-1499033518.gif[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]移动、瞄准、发射[/b][/size]
背包里携带可用弹弓并装好弹药，按住弹弓按钮拖动瞄准。蓄力后在原按钮圆圈外松手发射，在圆圈内松手取消。瞄准线帮助判断方向，无需先切换到弹弓所在的快捷栏格子。
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968401-1805210086.gif[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]近战就在手边[/b][/size]
用携带的近战武器攻击，保留游戏正常的攻击动作与衔接。
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968406-409248165.gif[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]采矿也少一步切换[/b][/size]
镐子按钮使用背包里的镐子，朝当前面向方向挥动。忙碌时不会把无效点击排队成之后意外触发的挥镐。
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968665-27653826.gif[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]下一层，由你决定何时下去[/b][/size]
点击放置楼梯，再自行与楼梯交互下楼。放置会使用游戏原生的附近位置搜索，仍然遵守楼层、碰撞和地形限制。[b]成功才消耗楼梯，不会自动下楼[/b]，也不会清除障碍、搜索整层或绕过地形限制。
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968664-2019274935.gif[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]你的屏幕，你的布局[/b][/size]
在布局编辑器中拖动按钮，选中按钮后调整大小，再保存。各动作可单独启用；摆放时为菜单和其他触控区域留出空间。0.4.8 的编辑控件使用游戏移动版原生菜单材质、字体和阴影。
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968673-1078160084.gif[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]需要时开启，随时收起[/b][/size]
屏幕 ON/OFF 开关可隐藏和恢复快捷动作；连接键盘时也可用 [b]F10[/b]。GMCM 支持可选的原生操作模式与摇杆布局切换，关闭模组时可恢复之前保存的控制设置。
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968672-1297314502.gif[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]提示也融入游戏[/b][/size]
放置成功、已使用食物、没有合适物品或无需恢复等结果，通过游戏原生 HUD 提示展示。字体、字号、位置、排队和淡出由游戏管理，旧的自定义通知字号滑条已移除。
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968834-994809511.gif[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]在 GMCM 中按习惯设置[/b][/size]
打开 [b]Quick Combat and Mining[/b]，选择 English 或简体中文，设置总开关、屏幕开关、各动作的显示与尺寸、布局、食物规则和可选的原生控制切换。
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968832-908444434.jpg[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968838-171178500.jpg[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968839-1711277095.jpg[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]安装与更新[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]安装兼容的 Android SMAPI 和 GMCM。[/*]
[*]将压缩包中的 [b]Quick Combat and Mining[/b] 文件夹解压到游戏的 [b]Mods[/b] 目录。[/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏，在 GMCM 中设置模组；携带相应工具、武器和消耗品，再开启屏幕开关。[/*]
[/list][b]从 0.4.7 更新：[/b]先关闭模组、保存并完全退出游戏，将旧模组文件夹备份到 Mods 之外。把 0.4.8 中的 [b]Quick Combat and Mining[/b] 覆盖到同名文件夹，保留自己的 [b]config.json[/b]；安装包不附带默认配置。
如果更早的版本使用不同文件夹名称，先将旧安装移出 Mods，再安装新版，按需迁移已备份的配置并在 GMCM 检查布局。[b]Mods 中只保留一份本模组。[/b]

[size=5][b]触控与游戏规则[/b][/size]
包含减少快捷操作期间误切快捷栏、摇杆干扰和双击误触的保护；背包、箱子、商店、GMCM 等全屏菜单仍可正常触控。工具、弹药与消耗品依然需要自行携带，本模组不提供无限物品、额外伤害、无敌或自动生成资源。

[size=5][b]反馈问题[/b][/size]
先检查工具和物品是否齐全、动作是否启用、开关是否为 ON，以及是否重复安装。反馈时请提供游戏、SMAPI、GMCM 和本模组版本、SMAPI 日志链接与复现步骤。

设计与维护：[b]y709408040[/b]。开发过程中使用了 ChatGPT/OpenAI 辅助。感谢星露谷、Android SMAPI 社区及测试玩家。
[i]本页全部演示来自作者录制的 0.4.8 素材。画面中可能出现其他已安装模组的 HUD 或特效，它们不属于本模组提供的功能。[/i][/spoiler]

[center][size=4][b]ENGLISH[/b][/size][/center]
Bring your most-used combat and mining actions within reach on [b]Stardew Valley Android[/b]. Keep moving with your left thumb while your right thumb handles [b]Slingshot, Melee, Pickaxe, Bomb, Staircase, and Food[/b]. Arrange the buttons around your screen, resize them, and hide or restore them with the on-screen ON/OFF switch.

[b]A refreshed look in 0.4.8:[/b] warm pixel-art circles, centered icons in their native item colors, a native-style layout editor, and the game's own HUD notices. All six actions and the familiar customization options remain available.

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 for Android with a compatible [b]SMAPI for Android[/b] installation.[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) — required.[/b] Install the official main file. The author's tested version is [b]1.16.0[/b]. GMCM provides this mod's in-game configuration menu.[/*]
[/list]Development setup: Stardew Valley Android 1.6.15.3 / SMAPI Android 4.3.2.5. Other Android SMAPI combinations may behave differently; this mod is built primarily for mobile play.
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968214-1328444355.jpg[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]Make room to explore.[/b][/size]
Place a normal Bomb from your inventory without hunting for its toolbar slot. Placement follows the game's native rules, and only successful placement consumes the item.
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968393-313580543.gif[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]Food. Drink. Keep going.[/b][/size]
The Food button checks food and drink buffs separately and fills missing categories first. Recovery selection considers non-buff food, matching buffs, and how much restoration you need, with preferences, exclusions, and fallback rules. [b]Each tap consumes at most one item; there is no background auto-eating.[/b] This clip shows two separate taps: one food, then one drink.
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968393-1499033518.gif[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]Move. Aim. Fire.[/b][/size]
Carry a usable, loaded slingshot. Hold and drag the Slingshot button to aim; once charged, release outside the original circle to fire or inside it to cancel. The aiming line helps you judge the direction, without selecting the slingshot's toolbar slot first.
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968401-1805210086.gif[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]Melee on tap.[/b][/size]
Use a carried melee weapon and keep its action close to your thumb. Attacks retain the game's normal animations and follow-up behavior.
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968406-409248165.gif[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]A quick swing, right here.[/b][/size]
The Pickaxe button swings your carried Pickaxe in the current facing direction. Busy-state taps are discarded rather than queued into an unexpected later swing.
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968665-27653826.gif[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]Your next floor is within reach.[/b][/size]
Place a Staircase, then interact with it when you want to descend. The game's native nearby placement search handles placement while normal floor, collision, and terrain restrictions still apply. [b]Only successful placement consumes a Staircase; the button does not automatically take you downstairs.[/b] It does not clear obstacles, search the whole floor, or bypass terrain rules.
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968664-2019274935.gif[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]Your screen. Your layout.[/b][/size]
Drag the action buttons into position, select a button to adjust its size, and save. Enable only the actions you want and leave room for menus and other touch controls. The 0.4.8 layout editor uses native mobile menu textures, game fonts, and shadows.
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968673-1078160084.gif[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]On when you need it.[/b][/size]
The on-screen ON/OFF switch hides and restores your quick actions. [b]F10[/b] also toggles them when a keyboard is available. Optional native control-mode and joystick-layout switching can apply your chosen setup while enabled and restore the saved controls when disabled.
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968672-1297314502.gif[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]Feedback that feels at home.[/b][/size]
Placement results, consumed food, and no-item or no-recovery-needed messages now use the game's native HUD notices. The game manages their font, size, position, queue, and fade. The old custom notice-size slider is no longer needed.
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968834-994809511.gif[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]Configure it in GMCM.[/b][/size]
Open [b]Quick Combat and Mining[/b] to choose English or Simplified Chinese, set the master and screen switches, select active actions, adjust positions and sizes, and configure Food rules and optional native controls.
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968832-908444434.jpg[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968838-171178500.jpg[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51933/51933-1788968839-1711277095.jpg[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]Installation and updating[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install compatible SMAPI for Android and Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*]Extract the [b]Quick Combat and Mining[/b] folder into your game's [b]Mods[/b] directory.[/*]
[*]Launch through SMAPI, configure the mod in GMCM, carry the matching tools and supplies, and turn the screen switch ON.[/*]
[/list][b]Updating from 0.4.7:[/b] disable the mod, save, and fully exit the game. Back up the existing folder outside Mods. Copy the 0.4.8 [b]Quick Combat and Mining[/b] folder over the same-named installation, keeping your own [b]config.json[/b]. No default config is bundled.
If an older release used a different folder name, move that installation outside Mods before installing this one. Copy your backed-up config if desired, then review the layout in GMCM. [b]Keep only one installation of this mod in Mods.[/b]

[size=5][b]Touch controls and game balance[/b][/size]
Input protections help reduce accidental toolbar switching, joystick interference, and unwanted double-tap interactions during quick-action use. Inventory, chest, shop, GMCM, and other full-screen menus remain touch-interactive. Tools, ammunition, and supplies are still required and consumed normally. The mod does not grant unlimited items, increased damage, invincibility, or automatic resource generation.

[size=5][b]Before reporting an issue[/b][/size]
Check that you have the matching tool/item, the action is enabled, the switch is ON, and only one copy is installed. Include your game, SMAPI, GMCM, and mod versions, a SMAPI log link, and clear reproduction steps.

[size=5][b]Credits[/b][/size]
Design and maintenance: [b]y709408040[/b]. Development included assistance from ChatGPT/OpenAI. Thanks to the Stardew Valley and Android SMAPI communities, and everyone who helped test the mobile controls.
[i]All demonstrations on this page come from the author's 0.4.8 recording. Other installed mods' HUD elements and effects may be visible; those are not features supplied by this mod.[/i]

Downloads.Description: Full Android release with six touch actions, refreshed native-style UI and game HUD notices. Requires Android SMAPI + GMCM (tested 1.16.0). Install Quick Combat and Mining in Mods; keep config.json when updating. Keep only one installation.

Manifest.Name: Quick Combat and Mining
Manifest.Description: Android quick actions with centered native item icons and native game HUD messages. Six action buttons, smart food/drink selection, reversible joystick layout, and touch protection.
